name: TUBACEX SERVICE SOLUTIONS INDIA PVT LTD
india_angle: Tubacex Service Solutions India Pvt Ltd is involved in manufacturing and supplying stainless steel tubing and pipes in India.
summary: Tubacex Service Solutions India Pvt Ltd specializes in manufacturing and supplying stainless steel tubing and corrosion-resistant materials. While their primary focus is on critical industrial applications, their materials can be used in semiconductor manufacturing environments where corrosion resistance is crucial.
